items.title: Widerspruch (objection) deadline
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring 6, 65549 Musterlimburg.
items.computation: Letter states 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben' (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). Versandtag = Saturday 21.11.2026. Counting the 4th day after: 22.11 (day1, Sun), 23.11 (day2, Mon), 24.11 (day3, Tue), 25.11 (day4, Wed) → Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) = 25.11.2026, which is itself not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so no shift is needed for the delivery date itself. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs per § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB: Bekanntgabe is an event occurring on 25.11.2026, so that day is excluded and the period begins on 26.11.2026; a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day on which the triggering event (25.11.2026) fell, i.e. 25.12.2026. That day (25.12.2026, 1. Weihnachtstag) is a public holiday in NW, as are 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag, a Saturday) and 27.12.2026 (Sunday). Per § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB the period is extended to the next working day, which is Monday 28.12.2026.

items.title: Unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) starts
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 erhalten Sie Arbeitslosengeld für 360 Kalendertage.
items.computation: Benefit start date is explicitly stated in the letter as 01.01.2027; no counting required.

items.title: Report as unemployed (if not already done)
items.quote: Melden Sie sich bitte am ersten Tag der Arbeitslosigkeit persönlich oder online arbeitslos, falls noch nicht geschehen.
items.computation: The letter instructs reporting on the first day of unemployment, which per the letter is 01.01.2027. This date falls on Neujahr (New Year's Day), a public holiday nationwide; in-person reporting at the office would not be possible that day, though the online ('online arbeitslos melden') channel may remain available. No statutory day-shifting rule (§ 193 BGB) clearly applies to this administrative instruction as it is not a classic Fristende, so the date is kept as stated but confidence is lowered.

warnings: The registration instruction falls on 01.01.2027, a public holiday, so the person should verify in advance whether in-person reporting is possible that day or whether only the online channel works, or whether reporting should be done on the next business day instead.
